checks.name: capability registry count and unique IDs
every capability has exactly one owning work package
work package statuses and acceptance are explicit
local links in architecture, tooling and product documents resolve
every capability appears once in the shared user interface map
shared interface families have unique identities and states
planned whole-journey scenarios have unique identities and acceptance evidence
research lifecycle covers required operational areas exactly once
lifecycle areas link to known planned journeys
operational journeys have known package owners and consistent reverse coverage
local and hosted delivery have explicit package gates
cross-cutting lifecycle and portability specifications resolve
original brand assets exist and match declared icon inventory
local brand font matches pinned provenance and includes its licence
brand tokens and reviewable desktop/narrow previews exist
recorded desktop and narrow accessibility preview checks passed
media result binds current model manifest
isolated R preparation library exists: r-library-platform
isolated R preparation library exists: r-library-methods
isolated R preparation library exists: r-library-implicit-methods

preserved_unavailable.fallback: OpenCV GrabCut; separately assessed compatible model version

external_inputs: Named hardware and licensed SDK access for claimed live profiles
Selected entitled facial/AU provider or locally pinned model with reference outputs
Source-bound procedure/scorer profiles and materials for newly enabled tasks
GitHub destination and selected distribution licence before publication
Selected HTTPS hosting/storage destination and operator configuration before opening hosted participant recruitment; local lab operation is independently deliverable
limitations: This reads recorded test evidence and verifies artifact presence/integrity; it does not rerun the tests.
Installed binaries are not evidence that all product routes, physical devices or populations are supported.
Planned usability scenarios are not participant findings; accessibility evidence covers the static brand preview only.
